verdict.rationale: First-party docs consistently describe Lovable generating a complete frontend+backend+database+auth app from natural-language prompts, backed by a built-in Cloud backend and autonomous Build/Agent mode (lovable-docs-1, lovable-docs-27, lovable-docs-31, lovable-docs-32, lovable-docs-5). Community reports corroborate that founders/PMs/CTOs do get functioning apps from prompts (lovable-comm-5, lovable-comm-9, lovable-comm-13), though other users report code-quality and scalability limitations for complex apps (lovable-comm-10, lovable-comm-1, lovable-comm-11). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of full-stack correctness across varied app types, and stronger evidence the generated backend/auth scales beyond prototypes.
